method: Probed on Microsoft's Analysis Services engine (black box): each probe deployed as a measure of Sales on model.bim (or run as a query), its state read from TMSCHEMA_MEASURES and, when accepted, evaluated at the grand total. Counts are the numbers the engine names in its argument-count errors for 0 and 40 arguments; null max means no count error at 40. Classes are BIcraft's own; no engine message text is stored.
